artboards.title: After the TX lock — nothing decided
After a fee policy document was read

annotations.text:
Two windows, four buckets (A 13 · B 9 · C 10 · D 3 — TX_FEE_FOUR_BUCKETS). Left = law sets it (loaded by the lock, read-only, ceiling/fixed/floor). Right = law defers (city decides; document → AI → proposed with page refs → approve). Approve = fee schedule VERSION 1, the thing estimates price from — so the 5 numbers that live in two places today get ONE home here.

DECIDED 2026-08-25 (Kevin): for every state template, a ceiling item's city value DEFAULTS TO THE CEILING — less setup work, and a demo city is priced from day one. The city can only lower it.

Open questions for Kevin: (1) RESOLVED — the mandate side now shows ONE ceiling per row (this city's: AG rate + 25%) and a "This city charges" column, refused above the cap; fixed rows read "as law". (2) Two mandate items need a requestor ledger — show as gaps (drawn) or hide? (3) Rows the document didn't cover: block approval (drawn) or approve partial? (4) Where does the SS (special service) context live — same screen, second version, or a tab?
